title: Lost Worlds
description:
S02 E11 — Lost Superpower of the Bible
Operating from their capital of Hattusha in what is now Turkey, the Hittites were a highly advanced military powerhouse that disappeared almost as quickly as they appeared in the ancient world.

title: Lost Worlds
description:
S02 E13 — City of Armageddon
Overlooking the Holy Land's Dead Sea is the ancient fortress of Masada, where Jewish rebels besieged by Roman soldiers staged a last stand until committing mass suicide.

title: Lost Worlds
description:
S01 E02 — Knights Templar
The city the Knights Templar knew as Tortosa now lies among modern homes in the Syrian city of Tartus.

title: Lost Worlds
description:
S02 E12 — Stalin's Supercity
Soviet dictator Josef Stalin causes the suffering and deaths of millions of citizens while envisaging a grandiose architectural plan.

title: Lost Worlds
description:
S02 E15 — The Age of Airships
Gigantic buildings house airships, the largest vehicles ever flown.

title: Decisive Battles
description:
Birth of the Roman Empire
The Battle of Cynoscephalae against Macedonia in 197 B.C. removes Rome's last rival for power in the Mediterranean.

title: Ancient Top 10
description:
S01 E08 — Greatest Ancient Monuments
The greatest monuments of the ancient world show more than wealth, they show power.

title: History's Crazy Rich Ancients
description:
S01 E10 — Holy Rollers
Meeting the ancients who bankrolled the construction of massive churches and temples in an attempt to buy their way past the pearly gates.

title: Ancient Top 10
description:
S01 E01 — Secrets of Egypt
The secrets surrounding Ancient Egypt, including the riddles of the Sphinx, mummification and the Pyramids.

title: The Dark Ages
description: Charlemagne, St. Benedict and the Empress Theodora help to bridge the gap of civilization between Rome and the Renaissance.

title: Warrior Queen Boudica
description: The ancient Celtic queen of the Iceni tribe spearheads a rebellion against the Romans.

description:
D-Day Special
On location in Dover, England and Normandy, France, Ermey focuses on the technology deployed on D-Day.

description:

description: The key events of the Allied invasion of Nazi-held Europe during World War II and honoring the diverse backgrounds of all who served, including the experiences of African-Americans, Asian Americans, Latinos and women.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S08 E29 — Armed Forces Tournament Part 1
Eight armed forces members redeploy to the forge for a three-part tournament where they will go head-to-head against one other smith in an intense five-hour battle.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S08 E30 — Armed Forces Tournament Part 2
In the second part of the Armed Forces Tournament, four U.S. service members redeploy to the forge floor to go head-to-head in one five-hour battle.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
Championship Short Swords
"Forged in Fire" judge Dave Baker revisits five of the most intense championship rounds featuring the top short swords to come out of the forge.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S07 E09 — Military Tribute
In honor of Veterans Day, four bladesmiths pay tribute in a special military themed competition, forging their blades from a panzer tank; two smiths have four days to recreate the Scottish Backsword as famously wielded by Captain Mad Jack Churchill.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S07 E02 — General Patton's Sabre
Four bladesmiths are tasked with forging a parameter specific blade shape in just two hours; two competitors survive the heat and the clock to make it back to their home forges to re-create an American hero's signature sword: Gen. Patton's saber.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
Best Of: Championship Curved Blades
"Forged in Fire" judge Dave Baker revisits five intense championship rounds; featuring the top curved blades to come out of the forge.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S08 E31 — Armed Forces Tournament Finale
On the finale of the Armed Forces Tournament, the four surviving smiths will face off to determine who wins it all.

title: Top Shot
description:
S02 E13 — Behind the Bullet
The marksmen discuss their skills, strategies and most controversial shots.

title: Top Shot All-Stars
description:
S05 E02 — Tricks of the Trade
Trick shots are used to determine who stays and who goes; three teams of five perform the Annie Oakley shot; bowling pin challenge; shooting pipes out of mannequins' mouths.

title: Top Shot All-Stars
description:
S05 E03 — Pick Your Poison
The 14 remaining marksmen choose their rivals for a head-to-head showdown with the SIG Sauer P229.

title: Top Shot All-Stars
description:
S05 E04 — Crank Trigger
Contestants test their skills with the Black Widow long bow; two contestants must adapt to the revolutionary Gatling gun to stay in the game.

title: Top Shot All-Stars
description:
S05 E05 — Shooting Dice
The competitors break into squads for a fierce side-by-side shoot out with the 1875 Remington pistol; two contestants fire against the clock with the Ruger 1022 rifle in an old-fashioned shooting gallery challenge.

title: Top Shot All-Stars
description:
S05 E06 — The Mile Shot
A long-range sniper shot challenge; marksmen are tested with the Barrett M-Rad; the prehistoric Atlatl.

title: Top Shot All-Stars
description:
S05 E01 — Best of the Best
A Soviet semi-automatic rifle used in the 1941 Nazi invasion; a tactical OBR with 20-round magazines; the Milkor M32A1 grenade launcher; an FN FAL self-loading selective fire battle rifle; a mortar-rigged barbed wire fence.
